Avery / Karthik — quick read: the MAP draft looks fine but recommend tightening the usage language and adding an escrow/takedown trigger section. Suggested bullets (short):
- License: "ephemeral evaluation license" — rights limited to evaluation use only; no copying, redistribution, or incorporation into production models; duration tied to sandbox window
- Escrow / takedown triggers: breach of terms, failed data handling audit, or explicit request from Nexa to terminate early; in any case, Redwood will perform a confirmed wipe and provide a signed certificate of destruction
- Output handling: aggregated metrics allowed; no raw prompt/testcase bundles in external systems without a separate license
- Auditability: Redwood to provide parquet export of request logs within 72 hours of request; logs kept for 90 days

I've attached a small sample manifest template for Nexa to fill (nexa_sample_manifest.csv). If legal wants a tighter phraseology we can run this through contracts, but this should be sufficient for an initial DocuSign MAP for the pilot.
